ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The thief-is-family answer explains why robbery cannot empty the impoverished house: the danger belongs within. Caoshan Benji gives the inherited answer, Xutang Zhiyu and Baofu Qinghuo reuse it directly, and Zhe’an Jingfan turns it into a verse requiring further examination.
